final: WITH race_averages AS (SELECT raceId, AVG(points) as avg_points, AVG(wins) as avg_wins FROM constructorStandings WHERE points > 6.0 GROUP BY raceId), overall_avg_wins AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) as overall_avg FROM race_averages WHERE avg_wins IS NOT NULL) SELECT ra.raceId, ra.avg_points, ra.avg_wins, ra.avg_wins - oaw.overall_avg as difference FROM race_averages ra, overall_avg_wins oaw WHERE oaw.overall_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CASE WHEN ra.avg_wins IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, difference DESC LIMIT 10
